quarterly_data.signal: Ferrotec's mid-term management plan (rolling update announced May 29, 2026, covering FY ending December 2026 to FY ending December 2028), as restated in its tender-offer notice: as semiconductor-related demand increases, the company will expand production in Malaysia and elsewhere (Kulim and Johor plants) to meet Japanese, European and US customers' need for manufacturing outside China (Ex-China) while strengthening customer support in China, focusing in particular on AI / data-center-related business. Targets for the final year (FY ending December 2028): consolidated net sales JPY 4,500 oku, operating profit JPY 570 oku, net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 380 oku, ROE 11%, ROIC 7%, equity ratio 40%; long-term vision for FY2030 (FY ending December 2030): consolidated net sales JPY 5,000 oku and net income JPY 500 oku.
